description: This file includes standalone versions of all TPT SVF coefficients calculators and filter sections that use them for use in gen~/GenExpr. Require this file to include any of the available filters for this type. So if you just need a standard high quality lowpass (for example), you need only require this file then call 'eviFilterLowpass(x, cutoff, db, Q, smooth=0)' in your code. These are the 'workhorse' linear filters of evieve and are used everywhere in the Package.
